review_points: Reverse LOCAL equals the transpose of D(x,y+q x), in the correct order.
q is only required to agree across stages within one port; no caller basis mixes different ports.
Binary ADD/SWAP bases introduce no dyadic coefficients or complex phase normalization.
The bare q output is a rank1 Gaussian target; finite restriction debits discarded low-rank complete target tuples.
Native helpers are independent public inputs and remain distinct from all main inputs and other source copies.
Owned nonzero CLEAR follows the explicitly retained owned_erasure hypothesis.
All paid native, thin, paired-idle and individual-idle events remain charged.
Finite target specialization fields and allocation/reset records are explicit in corrected fixed constants.

resolved_bookkeeping_finding.description: Specialized discarded targets must appear explicitly in the stock and ordinary record constants.

scope: Semantic/code review of the independent replay and exact finite/ordinary admission; does not reprove inherited native realization, compiler or analytic hypotheses. Full admission rerun is recorded by the parent auditor; this review avoids duplicating that expensive arithmetic.
